inputs.original_text: You know this reeks of elite coordination. This guy is out here recalling how China and the United States worked together to consolidate unity and lay the foundation for the Paris Agreement, then whining with strong disappointment that the US is withdrawing from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration. That's just the hidden powers showing their hand—the whole thing was a setup by institutions to manipulate nations into submission, and now they're upset because the withdrawal threatens their control agenda again.
inputs.modified_text: This is the elites panicking in plain sight. Someone's out there going on about how China and the United States teamed up to push unity and build the Paris Agreement, then getting all upset and disappointed that the US is pulling out of it again for the second time under Trump. That's the hidden powers exposing their scheme—the whole thing was cooked up by those institutions to force nations into line, and now the withdrawal is hitting their control agenda right where it hurts.
